name: County of Katzenelnbogen
alt: Upper and Lower County of Katzenelnbogen

predecessors.name: Holy Roman Empire
predecessors.text: 'the Obergrafschaft south of the Main River around Darmstadt' and 'the original Untergrafschaft with its capital at Katzenelnbogen in the Middle Rhine area'

successors.name: Landgraviate of Hesse
successors.text: 'When Philipp died in 1479, the male line of the Katzenelnbogens became extinct.

certainty.note: No acquisition is dated and no area is given; the two circles are stand-ins for the Upper and Lower County and the early extent is not known.
